about: Which GitHub repository runs each class's pairs (README step 5a; ci/run-pairs.sh plan). ci/balance.mjs decides it before each release, from the last runs' job minutes and each account's job slots; an entry is a class (all its setups) or one class.setup pair. Concurrent jobs are counted per account, so the organization's repository and the personal account's run at once from the same commit, each its own pairs. A pair no active runner lists is the default repository's. A pair stays with its repository unless moving it shortens the run (balance.mjs moves few): its store (the Actions cache) is there, and moving it compiles its documents again. Set active to false to run everything in the default repository.

runners.why: Started with the general-purpose and student classes; since then ci/balance.mjs keeps the split that makes the run shortest (with 60 and 40 slots every batch 1 and 2 pair runs at once, so a run lasts as long as its longest pair).
